```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here()) # knit from project directory

library(tidyverse)
theme_set(ggthemes::theme_few())
```

# Load data

```{r}

f_flower <- list.files("alldata/input/NPN/flower/", full.names = T, recursive = T)
flower <- read_csv(f_flower) |>
  filter(phenophase_description == "Open flowers")

f_leaf <- list.files("alldata/input/NPN/leaf/", full.names = T, recursive = T)
leaf <- read_csv(f_leaf)

```

# Data Cleaning 

## Load functions

```{r}
source(here::here("code", "clean_data.R"))
source(here::here("code", "clean_by_resolving_conflict.R"))
source(here::here("code", "clean_by_leading_no.R"))
source(here::here("code", "clean_by_trailing_yes.R"))
source(here::here("code", "clean_by_window.R"))
```

## Apply functions

``` {r}

flower_clean <- flower |>
  clean_data(
    calculate_observation_option = "by_year",
    min_leading_no = 1,
    leading_window_days = 14,
    min_trailing_yes = 1,
    trailing_window_days = 14,
    max_doy = 213
  )

leaf_clean <- leaf |>
  clean_data(
    calculate_observation_option = "by_year",
    min_leading_no = 1,
    leading_window_days = 14,
    min_trailing_yes = 1,
    trailing_window_days = 14,
    max_doy = 213
  )
```
#Calculate onset date and flower-leaf sequence

```{r}
source(here::here("code", "calc_first_yes.R"))
```

```{r}

flower_onset_clean <- flower_clean |>
  calc_first_yes()

leaf_onset_clean <- leaf_clean |>
  calc_first_yes()

#calculate by subtracting flower onset date from leaf onset date. Negative values would indicate leaves emerged first

merged_df <- inner_join(
  leaf_onset_clean |>
    select(latitude, longitude, genus, species, common_name, individual_id, year, leaf = day_of_first_yes),
  flower_onset_clean |>
    select(latitude, longitude, genus, species, common_name, individual_id, year, flower = day_of_first_yes)
) |>
  mutate(fls = leaf - flower)

```

# Test Hypotheses 

## Patterns in FLS among individuals within species along a latitudinal gradient

### By Genus
```{r}

#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 4

merged_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = latitude, y = fls)) +
  geom_point(aes(col = species), alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth(aes(col = species, group = species), method = MASS::rlm, se = F, linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ genus) +
  geom_smooth(method = MASS::rlm) +
  labs(x = "Latitude", y = "Flower Leaf Sequence") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

```{r}
lmerTest::lmer(fls ~ latitude + (1 + latitude | species), data = merged_df) |> summary()
```
```{r}
lmerTest::lmer(fls ~ latitude + (1 + latitude | species) + (1 + latitude | year), data = merged_df) |> summary()
```

### Maple Species
```{r}

#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 4

merged_df |>
  filter(genus == "Acer") |>
  filter(species != "freemanii" & species != "glabrum") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = latitude, y = fls)) +
  geom_point(aes(col = species), alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth(aes(col = species, group = species), method = MASS::rlm, se = F, linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ species) +
  geom_smooth(method = MASS::rlm) +
  labs(x = "Latitude", y = "Flower Leaf Sequence") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```
We removed two maple species because they did not have enough observations (<3 total across all years)

```{r}
lmerTest::lmer(fls ~ latitude + (1 + latitude | species), data = merged_df |> filter(genus == "Acer")) |> summary()
```
```{r}
lmerTest::lmer(fls ~ latitude + (1 + latitude | species) + (1 | year), data = merged_df |> filter(genus == "Acer")) |> summary()
```

## Patterns in FLS across species along a latitudinal gradient

```{r}

fls_genus <- merged_df |>
  group_by(genus, year) |>
  summarize(latitude = median(latitude), fls = median(fls))

fls_genus |>
  ggplot(aes(x = latitude, y = fls)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_point(aes(col = genus), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(aes(col = genus), method = MASS::rlm, se = F) +
  geom_smooth(method = MASS::rlm) +
  labs(x = "Latitude", y = "Leaf - Flower")
```

```{r}
lm(fls ~ latitude, data = fls_genus) |> summary()
```

```{r}

fls_species <- merged_df |>
  filter(genus == "Acer") |>
  group_by(genus, species) |>
  summarize(latitude = median(latitude), fls = median(fls))

fls_species |>
  ggplot(aes(x = latitude, y = fls)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_point(aes(col = species), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(aes(col = species), method = MASS::rlm, se = F) +
  geom_smooth(method = MASS::rlm) +
  labs(x = "Latitude", y = "Leaf - Flower")
```
```{r}
lm(fls ~ latitude, data = fls_species) |> summary()
```
